name: Wireless Bluetooth Headphones
description: Premium noise-cancelling wireless headphones with 30-hour battery life, deep bass, and comfortable over-ear design. Features Bluetooth 5.3, multipoint connection, and a foldable design for travel.

name: Minimalist Leather Watch
description: Elegant analog watch with genuine leather strap, sapphire crystal glass, and Japanese quartz movement. Water-resistant to 50 meters with a sleek minimalist dial.

name: Organic Cotton T-Shirt
description: Soft, breathable organic cotton t-shirt with a relaxed fit. Pre-shrunk fabric, reinforced seams, and eco-friendly dyes. Available in multiple colors.

name: Smart Water Bottle
description: Temperature-displaying vacuum-insulated bottle with hydration reminder LED. Double-wall stainless steel keeps drinks cold 24h or hot 12h. 500ml capacity.

name: Mechanical Keyboard
description: Hot-swappable mechanical keyboard with Cherry MX switches, per-key RGB lighting, and a compact 75% layout. Includes USB-C, PBT keycaps, and foam dampening.

name: Canvas Backpack
description: Vintage-style waxed canvas backpack with padded laptop compartment (fits 15"), multiple organizer pockets, and genuine leather trim. 25L capacity.

name: Wireless Charging Pad
description: 15W fast wireless charger compatible with iPhone and Android. Slim aluminum design with LED indicator and foreign object detection. Includes USB-C cable.

name: Wool Blend Sweater
description: Cozy wool-cashmere blend sweater with ribbed cuffs and hem. Perfect for layering. Machine washable with a timeless crew neck design.

name: Ceramic Coffee Mug Set
description: Handcrafted set of 4 ceramic mugs with minimalist glaze finish. Microwave and dishwasher safe. Each holds 350ml. Unique reactive glaze per piece.

name: Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: Rugged IP67 waterproof speaker with 20W output, 360-degree sound, and 12-hour battery. Built-in microphone, USB-C charging, and carabiner clip.

name: Denim Jacket
description: Classic denim jacket in medium wash. Button front, two chest pockets, and adjustable waist tabs. 100% cotton with a comfortable regular fit.

name: Stainless Steel Tumbler
description: Double-wall vacuum insulated tumbler with spill-resistant lid. Keeps drinks cold 24h or hot 6h. Fits most car cup holders. 600ml capacity.
